services.desc: Come see what the hype in Virginia Beach is all about! Atlantic Fun Park boasts over 10 Midway Games and 15 Rides! Ride tickets can by bought by the piece or can be bought using an unlimited ride band. Midway Games are charged per play and are charged separately from tickets. All prices are per person. Prices do not include City of Virginia Beach 10% admission tax. All prices are per person. Prices do not include City of Virginia Beach 10% admission tax.
